mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO CHB_EQUDET T USING (
SELECT '${item.busiSeqno}' AS BUSI_SEQNO, '${item.account}' AS ACCOUNT, '${item.accountName}' AS ACCOUNT_NAME, '${item.registBankCode}' AS REGIST_BANK_CODE, '${item.indentifyMark}' AS INDENTIFY_MARK, #{item.eQuityConfDate,jdbcType=DATE}null EQUITY_CONF_DATE, '${item.busiType}' AS BUSI_TYPE, '${item.ccy} AS CCY, ${item.amount}null AMOUNT, ${item.converCnyAmount}null COVER_CNY_AMOUNT, ${item.shares}null SHARES, '${item.channel}' AS CHANNEL, '${item.fundAcc}' AS FUND_ACC, '${item.fundAccBank}' AS FUND_ACC_BANK, '${item.isSubmit}' AS IS_SUBMIT, '${item.isConsign}' AS IS_CONSIGN, '${item.remark}' AS REMARK, '${item.dataSource}' AS DATA_SOURCE, '${item.status}' AS STATUS, '${item.workflowId}' AS WORKFLOW_ID, '${item.createDept}' AS DEPT_CODE, '${item.updateUser}' AS UPDATE_USER, #{item.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}null UPDATE_TIME, '${item.createUser}' AS CREATE_USER, #{item.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}null CREATE_TIME FROM sysibm.sysdummy1 ) T1 ON (T1.BUSI_SEQNO= T.BUSI_SEQNO AND T1.INDENTIFY_MARK = T.INDENTIFY_MARK AND T1.REGIST_BANK_CODE = T.REGIST_BANK_CODE)
WHEN MATCHED THEN
INSERT (BUSI_SEQNO,ACCOUNT,ACCOUNT_NAME,REGIST_BANK_CODE,INDENTIFY_MARK, EQUITY_CONF_DATE,BUY_PLACE,BUSI_TYPE,CCY,AMOUNT,COVER_CNY_AMOUNT, SHARES,CHANNEL,FUND_ACC,FUND_ACC_BANK,IS_SUBMIT,IS_CONSIGN,REMARK, DATA_SOURCE,STATUS,WORKFLOW_ID,DEPT_CODE,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_USER,CREATE_TIME) VALUES (T1.BUSI_SEQNO,T1.ACCOUNT,T1.ACCOUNT_NAME,T1.REGIST_BANK_CODE,T1.INDENTIFY_MARK, T1.EQUITY_CONF_DATE,T1.BUY_PLACE,T1.BUSI_TYPE,T1.CCY,T1.AMOUNT,T1.COVER_CNY_AMOUNT, T1.SHARES,T1.CHANNEL,T1.FUND_ACC,T1.FUND_ACC_BANK,T1.IS_SUBMIT,T1.IS_CONSIGN,T1.REMARK, T1.DATA_SOURCE,T1.STATUS,T1.WORKFLOW_ID,T1.DEPT_CODE,T1.UPDATE_USER,T1.UPDATE_TIME, T1.CREATE_USER,T1.CREATE_TIME)
UPDATE SET
T.#{cover}=T1.#{cover}
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (BUSI_SEQNO,ACCOUNT,ACCOUNT_NAME,REGIST_BANK_CODE,INDENTIFY_MARK, EQUITY_CONF_DATE,BUY_PLACE,BUSI_TYPE,CCY,AMOUNT,COVER_CNY_AMOUNT, SHARES,CHANNEL,FUND_ACC,FUND_ACC_BANK,IS_SUBMIT,IS_CONSIGN,REMARK, DATA_SOURCE,STATUS,WORKFLOW_ID,DEPT_CODE,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_USER,CREATE_TIME) VALUES (T1.BUSI_SEQNO,T1.ACCOUNT,T1.ACCOUNT_NAME,T1.REGIST_BANK_CODE,T1.INDENTIFY_MARK, T1.EQUITY_CONF_DATE,T1.BUY_PLACE,T1.BUSI_TYPE,T1.CCY,T1.AMOUNT,T1.COVER_CNY_AMOUNT, T1.SHARES,T1.CHANNEL,T1.FUND_ACC,T1.FUND_ACC_BANK,T1.IS_SUBMIT,T1.IS_CONSIGN,T1.REMARK, T1.DATA_SOURCE,T1.STATUS,T1.WORKFLOW_ID,T1.DEPT_CODE,T1.UPDATE_USER,T1.UPDATE_TIME, T1.CREATE_USER,T1.CREATE_TIME)
